thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Critical: AZ-b egress failures detected for VPC vpc-6a2c; multiple NAT gateway timeouts and TCP resets observed across 3 subnets. Pager triggered at 2006001234.
carla_oncall: I'm on it. Anyone already checking NAT health? 
ben_net: looking. Seeing high TCP RST counts from instances in subnet private-azb-2. NAT gw nat-azb-2 shows 500+ conn resets in 60s.
alice_ops: FYI we ran a small terraform apply on azb-subnets ~8m ago to update tagging. Could be related.
derek_sre: @carla_oncall I see route table changes too — route-table-azb-priv got a new association around 2006001180 per CloudTrail. Could be a race with NACLs.
carla_oncall: good catch. ben, can you dump the NACL rules for private-azb-2? 
ben_net: grabbing now. Output: ```
Inbound NACL acl-0a: 100 ALLOW 0.0.0.0/0 ALL
Inbound NACL acl-0a: 110 DENY 10.0.0.0/16 TCP:1024-65535
Outbound NACL acl-0a: 100 ALLOW 0.0.0.0/0 ALL
Outbound NACL acl-0a: 120 DENY 0.0.0.0/0 TCP:80,443
```
carla_oncall: whoa outbound DENY 120 to 0.0.0.0/0 TCP 80/443 — that would break egress HTTP(s) through NAT. When was that applied?
alice_ops: it looks like an unintended rule from the tagging deploy — terraform added a policy ACL entry to lock down ephemeral ports but the rule number collides with preexisting rules. The change record: user alice_ops automation-runner at 2006001178.
evan_support: customers reporting 502s and model inference timeouts for EU-west-1 users routed via AZ-b. Impacting hosted API tenants — about ~18% error rate in the last 5m per metrics.
monitoring-bot: Top affected services: /v1/generate (80% of errors), embeddings (15%). Error spikes started at 2006001210.
derek_sre: mitigation plan: 1) remove offending outbound DENY NACL rule 120 2) failover traffic to nat-azb-1 by updating subnet's route table to nat-azb-1 3) monitor. Who can apply quick rollback?
carla_oncall: ben, can you remove NACL rule 120 now? I'll prepare a rollback route assoc to nat-azb-1. 
ben_net: removing rule... ```aws ec2 replace-network-acl-entry --network-acl-id acl-0a --egress --rule-number 120 --rule-action allow --port-range From=80,To=443 --cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0``` Running now.
ben_net: done. Confirmed outbound rule 120 now ALLOW. Conn resets dropping in latest 30s sample.
carla_oncall: applying route change to private-azb-2: associate route-table-azb-priv -> set nat gateway to nat-azb-1 (manual override). Command: ```aws ec2 replace-route --route-table-id rtb-azb-priv --destination-cidr-block 0.0.0.0/0 --nat-gateway-id nat-azb-1```
alice_ops: route change applied. Traffic shifting.
evan_support: customer impact decreasing — error rate down to ~6% and counting. Complaints still trickling in.
derek_sre: good. Let's keep nat-azb-1 in use while we finish postmortem. We should also revert terraform change that caused the NACL drift. @alice_ops can you open revert PR?
alice_ops: opening PR now — will mark as urgent and link to incident.
carla_oncall: on-call handoff: @derek_sre will take ownership for the next 30m to monitor and coordinate remediation. I'm pausing pager escalation.
derek_sre: acknowledged. I'll keep alerts on and run elevated telemetry checks.
monitoring-bot: Next check in 5m: RT latency and egress error rate.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2006001234. Severity: Sev2 (customer-impacting but mitigated). Initial customer impact estimate: ~120 tenants transiently affected, peak error rate ~18%, median restoration time 7m after mitigation.
carla_oncall: notes for postmortem: root cause — terraform NACL change with rule-number collision that produced outbound DENY for 80/443. Contributing factor — route assoc race that delayed failover. Action items: (1) add terraform plan guardrails for NACL rule numbers, (2) automatic NACL rule collision detection, (3) add sanity check post-network-change to validate egress for control-plane endpoints, (4) run tabletop for AZ failover.
evan_support: I'll draft customer-facing blurb: "We experienced transient egress failures in AZ-b impacting API requests; mitigation completed and services restored. We are investigating root cause and will provide postmortem."
carla_oncall: thanks everyone. Derek, keep slack updated and escalate if any regression. Closing this thread after 30m if stable. :white_check_mark:
